title: active reviewing validation refs gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求 active 和 reviewing item 有非空 validation_refs。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh active/reviewing validation_refs check; /tmp missing-validation-refs fixture reports items:knowledge-hub-root active/reviewing missing validation_refs
risk: 只检查证据入口存在，不执行验证命令。

title: validation refs list shape gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求 validation_refs 是非空字符串列表。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh validation_refs list and string check; /tmp validation-refs-type fixture reports items:knowledge-hub-root validation_refs must be list
risk: 命令型 ref 只做结构检查，不解析命令语义。

title: validation refs local path gate
decision: 默认 knowledge-check 要求本地路径型 validation_refs 使用仓库内规范相对路径并指向存在的 Knowledge Hub 文件；绝对路径、./、../ 和不支持的路径样式 ref 不静默跳过。
evidence: tools/knowledge-check.sh validation_ref local path and format checks; /tmp missing-local-validation-ref fixture reports validation_ref missing local path; /tmp dot-slash-validation-ref and abs-validation-ref fixtures report validation_ref must be repo-relative or command; /tmp unsupported-validation-ref fixture reports unsupported validation_ref format
risk: 含空格的命令型 ref 不做路径检查，避免误判命令字符串；命令本身仍只登记不执行。
